categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Jiuwu Hi-Tech Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, development, and application of separation materials and technologies, including ceramic membranes, organic membranes, and lithium adsorbents. The company provides integrated membrane technology solutions, materials, components, and system integration mainly for industrial process separation and environmental water treatment sectors. It also engages in lithium extraction materials production through its subsidiary, targeting the lithium resource industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced membrane separation technologies including ceramic membranes made from alumina, zirconia, and titania, and organic polymer membranes such as ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, and reverse osmosis membranes. It has proprietary lithium adsorbent materials (titanium-based and aluminum-based) for selective lithium ion adsorption from brine. The company integrates membrane materials with system design, manufacturing, and operational services to deliver complete membrane separation solutions. It emphasizes continuous R&D and innovation in membrane materials, adsorption technologies, and integrated membrane systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in industries such as new energy (especially lithium extraction for batteries), chemical, biopharmaceutical, environmental water treatment, metallurgy, papermaking, and municipal water supply. The company serves industrial process separation needs and environmental wastewater treatment, including industrial wastewater zero discharge projects. It also targets emerging markets like salt lake lithium extraction and industrial waste resource recycling.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Nanjing and production facilities including a subsidiary in Tibet. It has expanded overseas with projects in Southeast Asia, South America, Northeast Asia, and Central Asia, including India, Indonesia, South Korea, and Kazakhstan. Domestic sales dominate, accounting for over 95% of revenue, but export and overseas business are growing rapidly.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Jiuwu Hi-Tech operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It produces core separation membrane materials and lithium adsorbents (midstream), manufactures membrane modules and complete membrane equipment, and provides integrated membrane technology solutions and operational services to end customers (downstream).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in ceramic and organic membrane materials, lithium adsorbents, and integrated membrane systems. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 10% of revenue spent on research, focusing on high-performance materials like silicon carbide ceramic membranes and advanced lithium adsorbents. It also develops new applications in special water treatment, industrial waste recycling, and energy transition sectors. Digital transformation and smart manufacturing are strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of integrated membrane technology solutions, including membrane materials, components, and complete membrane equipment. The company also earns income from technical service contracts, system integration, and operational support. Sales are mostly direct to industrial and municipal customers, with some revenue from overseas projects and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Jiuwu Hi-Tech is recognized as a leading domestic enterprise in the ceramic membrane field and membrane separation industry in China. It holds multiple national awards and patents, and is acknowledged as a 'leading enterprise' in the Chinese membrane industry. The company competes with both domestic and international membrane technology providers, leveraging its strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product portfolio, and integrated solutions to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 533 million, a 29.55% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to project delays and market fluctuations. However, net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 16.9% to about RMB 53 million, supported by growth in lithium adsorbent sales and improved product mix. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.93 billion and equity of RMB 1.25 billion, showing steady growth and improving profitability despite revenue volatility.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary high-performance ceramic and organic membrane materials and lithium adsorbents with superior separation efficiency, chemical resistance, and durability. It offers comprehensive membrane integration solutions tailored to diverse industrial processes, ensuring optimized performance and cost-effectiveness. Its unique 'adsorption + membrane' lithium extraction technology and zero-discharge wastewater treatment solutions provide environmental and economic benefits, differentiating it in the market as a technology leader with strong service capabilities.
